chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, and a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad, all from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
The place of prostration of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was recognized by the pleasant scent of it.
ai.seo_question: What was the sign of the place of prostration of Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the physical manifestation of spiritual purity (*fitrah*) in Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), where the scent of his prostration spot served as a tangible sign of his divine proximity. In Shia tradition, such sensory miracles (*karamat*) are viewed not merely as supernatural events but as confirmations of the Imam's unique spiritual station and the purity of his worship.
